deprecated_reason: Hand-maintained and not regenerated since an early v19.4 draft; its module/question-id lists (e.g. symptoms_female_reproductive, symptoms_oral_head_neck) no longer match the live symptomGroups ids in app.js (symptoms_gynecological, symptoms_oral_throat, etc.), and its row_only_question_ids/basic module list included 'race' without ever documenting why. Discovered during a 2026-08-20 audit checking whether the race question's canonical-contract exclusion was consistently reflected across the repo.
use_instead: contracts/v1/answer-code-manifest.json (auto-generated by scripts/generate-answer-code-manifest.js directly from the live app.js questions array on every run of that script -- always in sync, unlike this file). See DATA_CONTRACT.md section 3 for why 'race' specifically is excluded from the canonical answer contract.
note_for_build-backend-handoff-package.j: This file is still copied into generated handoff packages under 01_questionnaire/questionnaire-manifest.json for historical continuity with prior packages; readers of a handoff package should treat contracts/v1/answer-code-manifest.json (copied alongside it) as authoritative instead.
